catherine.p2: For the past 9 years, Catherine has run her own business advising international clients on investing and doing business in a diverse range of sectors in Sub-Saharan Africa. Her experience includes the extractives industry, agriculture, and the associated supply chains; particularly in Mozambique and its neighbouring countries.
catherine.p3: Based between Europe and Africa, Catherine has used her experience in business and longstanding connection with Mozambique to develop Appload with Claire.

faq1.title: What is Appload?
faq1.description: Appload is a digital marketplace for logistics services. Using Appload’s app or web-based platform, shippers and carriers can connect to plan, book, and monitor cargo shipments.

description.p1: If you are a licensed transport provider, you may register to provide services through Appload. If you have cargo to ship, provided that it is in compliance with Appload’s terms and conditions, you may register to ship your goods using Appload.
description.p2: Appload is accessible to anyone with sufficient internet connection to download and operate the app, which is designed to function even in low bandwidth areas.

faq3.title: What services does Appload provide?
faq3.description: Appload acts as a neutral indermediary, providing a digital platform on which transporters and their customers can connect, giving both shippers and carriers greater market access. Appload also offers a secure booking and electronic payments system; cargo insurance through a third party partner; and monitors trips arranged through Appload until proof of successful delivery. Appload provides its users with a customer review system, allowing them to rate each other as clients and service providers and making this information available to other customers, allowing them to make more informed business choices.

faq4.title: Does Appload have its own fleet of trucks?
faq4.description: Appload is an agent that connects professional transporters and their customers and oversees trips arranged through its platform. It does not own or operate its own vehicles.

faq5.title: What kind of transport can be arranged through Appload?
faq5.description: Appload currently works with road transporters. Any vehicle that is legal and operated by a licensed transporter may offer services on the platform.

faq6.title: Does it cost money to register on and use Appload?
faq6.description: It is free to register for Appload’s core package of services. A modest seller’s fee is included in the overall transport price per trip. This is charged on a sliding scale, depending on factors including the number of trucks registered by a provider on the platform, trip volume and distance.

faq7.title: What are Appload’s key principles and business ethos?
faq7.description: Appload is committed to the development of an increasingly professional and reliable logistics industry that ensures value for money at every level of the supply chain. Our modern, digital platform and focus on facilitating excellent communication aims to build trust among our customers, creating a more cohesive logistics community and a more structured, efficient and transparent system that works for everybody.

faq1.title: What do I need to register on Appload?

description.text: All legally registered businesses may register on Appload. You will be asked for certain documents to validate your identity and enable you to use our online booking and payments system, including
description.bullet2: the company’s administrative info (Address, Contact Info, )
description.bullet4: the company’s alvara or updated commercial certification

faq2.title: What are the terms of payment on Appload?
faq2.description: The shipper pays 100% of the total cost upfront to Appload. Appload pays the transporter 50% of its fee after successful loading of the cargo, and 50% seven business days after the successful delivery of the cargo.

faq3.title: Can I insure my cargo on Appload?
faq3.description: Appload indicates if the transporter has a cargo insurance of their own and what this covers. Many transporters do have Goods In Transit insurance and Appload encourages them to do so. In cases where they may not, you can insure your cargo for competive prices on Appload’s platform through our partner broker. You may also wish to purchase this insurance as an extra, even if the transporter has GIT insurance.

faq4.title: What kind of cargo can be transported by Appload’s transporters?
faq4.description: Any type of cargo (eg grain, fruit, construction material, medicines) as long as it complies with Appload’s terms and conditions, which prohibit the transport of illegal or dangerous cargo.

faq5.title: Where does Appload ship in Mozambique?
faq5.description: Appload is a nationwide service. You can ship anywhere in Mozambique, depending on the availability of Appload’s transporters and the current condition of the roads and other infrastructure.

faq6.title: Does Appload cover regional trips?
faq6.description: Appload’s current services focus on domestic trips within Mozambique. We will inform our customers when Appload starts covering regional trips.

faq7.title: Do I pay to use Appload?
faq7.description: Shippers using Appload’s standard service are not required to pay any fee to Appload; all charges are included in the quotation made by the transporter. If Shippers wish to set prices and invite transporters to accept them, rather than receiving quotations, they may sign up to a Corporate Package with Appload. This arrangement is currently agreed on a case by case basis, and will be offered for exceptionally competitive rates during Appload’s pilot phase.

faq8.title: How do I pay on Appload?
faq8.description: Once you’ve accepted the offer of a transporter, and once he’s confirmed his availability, you will be redirected to the web page powered by our partner PagaLu, which will offer you several means of payment (visa/mastercard debit/credit cards powered by Standard Bank, Mobile payment (as of now, MPesa is available), or alternatively, you can select the bank transfers and will have access to our bank account details for different banks.

faq1.title: What do I need to register on Appload?

description.text1: Any legally registered transporter may register on Appload. You must provide your bank account details and a set of documents including:
description.bullet1: The ID of the company representant
description.bullet3: B.R. - Boletim da República - Mozambican companies only
description.bullet5: Start of business - Mozambican companies only
description.bullet8: Bank Letter (With the company details for payments)
description.text2: Currently it is also necessary to make personal contact with Appload (phone meeting first, and then a visit by Appload’s staff). This is part of a due diligence process to ensure the highest possible quality service is provided to Appload’s clients, and also to assist Carriers with the registration process, making it as easy as possible.

faq2.title: What are the terms of payment on Appload?

p1.text1: The Shipper pays Appload 100% of the total cost upfront, the transporter is paid 50% of their fee after successful loading of the cargo (
p1.bold: in order for this to be effected it is essential that the status of ‘Loaded’ is updated by the driver on the app
p1.text2: ), and 50% seven business days after successful delivery of the cargo (and update of the status ‘Completed’ by the driver on the app).

description.p2: If cargo loss or damage is reported by the Shipper, payment may take longer to be processed while the matter is investigated and resolved to the satisfaction of all parties.

faq3.title: Do I need a license to register on Appload?

description.p1: You need to have a formally registered and operating company to register on Appload.
description.p2: Depending on the size of your fleet, you might need a company license or a license per truck to be a partner transporter of Appload.

faq4.title: Do I need an insurance?
faq4.description: You need to prove that you hold third party insurance for each truck registered on the platform (It can be a common third party insurance policy covering all the fleet owned by your company). GIT insurance is not currently mandatory but is encouraged.

faq5.title: Does Appload cover regional trips?
faq5.description: Appload’s current services focus on domestic trips within Mozambique. We will inform our customers when Appload starts covering regional trips.

faq6.title: Do I pay to use Appload?
faq6.description: It is free to register on Appload. Appload charges a modest commission for its services, which is a percentage of the quotation you offer to the client. You will see this clearly stated when you insert your quotation, and may raise the quotation before submitting it as a formal offer if required. This commission will be deducted by Appload from the total paid by the client, and you will receive the full fee that you listed as a quotation.

faq7.title: Do my drivers need a smartphone?

description.p1: Yes they do, but these phones can be very simple and cheap (as little as MZN 1,100) and the driver app is very intuitive and easy to use, as proven during operational use by drivers.
description.p2: If your driver does not have the required type of phone, Appload can for a small fee provide your company with feature phones with the App already installed and ready to use.
description.p3: Appload provides training on the App to all interested drivers.

faq8.title: Will the drivers of my company have contact with the client on a specific trip? What information will drivers have access to?

description.p1: Appload is aware of the commercial and internal management needs of transport companies vis a vis driver management and control of client relationships.
description.p2: If the driver works for a company, they will not have access to the clients’ detailed contacts, and reciprocally, the communication will be done through Appload. Drivers will have no direct communication with the shipper and vice versa, so you as the company remain in control of your business.
description.p3: The driver will also not have access to commercially sensitive information such as the price of the transport or the value of the goods. Driver access is limited to essential information and input via the Driver app which is needed to ensure proper monitoring of the trip. You the transport company have full access to this data and can see what is happening during each trip.

faq1.question: WHAT IS CARGO TRANSPORT INSURANCE?
faq1.answer: Cargo transport insurance is a type of insurance product that protects goods against losses or damages that occur during their transportation.

faq2.question: WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF CARGO TRANSPORT INSURANCE?
faq2.answer: Cargo transport insurance provides financial stability to the business. It helps manage risks and conduct business with fewer worries. It compensates for financial losses incurred during the transit of goods under the policy.

faq3.question: WHAT TYPE OF GOODS ARE COVERED UNDER APPLOAD/HOLLARD'S COMMERCIAL OFFER THAT CAN BE INSURED FOR FREE?
faq3.answer: Only dry agricultural goods may be eligible for free insurance, within the budget limit available by Appload. In each case, Appload and Hollard will confirm if the type of goods and the type of transport (route, trucks, etc.) are eligible for free insurance.

answer.description: Here are the three types of cargo insurance available, along with the corresponding events they cover:
answer.bullet1: Basic Insurance: Covers Fire, Collision, and Overturning.
answer.bullet2: Basic Insurance + Theft: Covers Fire, Collision, Overturning, and Theft.
answer.bullet3: Multi risk insurance.Please contact Hollard for the detailed policy for each type of insurance.

faq5.question: WHAT DOES CARGO INSURANCE NOT COVER?

answer.description: Regardless of the type of insurance you subscribe to, the cargo insurance does not cover the following:
answer.bullet2: Normal leakage, loss in weight or volume.
answer.bullet5: Financial insolvency or default or absence of employees.

faq6.question: WHAT IS THE BASIS FOR CALCULATING THE CARGO TRANSPORT INSURANCE PREMIUM?

answer.description: The cargo transport insurance premium is calculated based on several factors, such as:
answer.bullet2: The type of goods and their risk level.
answer.bullet3: The route and mode of transport (land, sea, air).

faq7.question: WHAT IS A DEDUCTIBLE?
faq7.answer: A deductible is the initial amount that the insured must pay in the event of a claim. The insured pays the deductible amount for each claim, and if the loss is less than the deductible, the insurer does not make any payment.

faq8.question: WHAT SHOULD I DO IN CASE OF AN INCIDENT DURING TRANSPORT?

answer.description: Em caso de incidente durante o transporte, por favor proceda da seguinte forma:
answer.bullet2: Take reasonable measures to minimize damages.
answer.bullet3: Collect and preserve all evidence of the incident(photos, reports, witnesses).
answer.bullet4: Provide all necessary documents to the insurer, such as the insurance policy, commercial invoice, shipping guide, and inspection report.

faq9.question: HOW CAN I BE SURE THAT THE CARRIERS LISTED IN THE APP ARE QUALIFIED AND RELIABLE?

answer.description: Before authorizing a carrier to use Appload, Appload conducts a thorough verification process, which includes checking the following information:
answer.bullet1: up-to-date administrative documents of the company
answer.bullet2: the transport license of the company, or in the case of small businesses, the truck logbook, updated
answer.bullet3: references from clients regarding past work. For any confirmed trip on Appload, Appload has ongoing truck logbooks and driver documents.

faq10.question: CAN I SCHEDULE TRANSPORTS IN ADVANCE OR MAKE CHANGES TO AN EXISTING TRANSPORT THROUGH THE APP?

answer.bullet1: For any request on Appload, it is necessary to specify the desired loading date. You can request a date of your choice.
answer.bullet2: Additionally, you can make changes to certain parameters of the request, which will require validation from the carrier. If there is a change in cost, depending on the progress of the request (whether it has not yet been confirmed by the carrier or is in progress), the client and the carrier must agree on revising the quotation. If the cargo is insured, depending on the change, Hollard must also be informed and may need to adjust the cost of coverage.
